title: Make the WR_* code set countable: one spelling at every call site

outcomes.statement: Every fail()/cliError() call site spells its code with the WR_ prefix, so the code set is greppable and countable rather than split across two spellings normalised at throw time.
outcomes.demo: A source-level test finds zero bare codes; the full suite passes unchanged because every surfaced code string is identical.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the doc and schema declare 23 codes the implementation cannot raise, as CHG-034's correction log states.
uncertainties.resolution: They declare ZERO. The doc and schema name no WR_* code as a token, at CHG-034's start or today; the 23-code gap was my own census globbing scripts/*.mjs and picking up the test file. AC7 is re-scoped to the real defect the same measurement exposed: 36 of 88 call sites use a bare spelling that fail() prefixes at throw time, so the true code set is 87, not the 52 every figure in this rollout has reported.
